source.member: ACE.Server.Managers.QuestManager (non-player Creature): Update, Stamp, Increment, Decrement, Erase, EraseAll, SetQuestCompletions, SetQuestBits, HasQuest, HasQuestCompletes, GetQuest, CanSolve, IsMaxSolves, GetMaxSolves, GetCurrentSolves, GetNextSolveTime, HasQuestSolves, HasQuestBits, HasNoQuestBits, GetQuestName
source.notes: Steps run in order. Each script starts a fresh manager (in.reset = true). in: {op, quest, a, b, now, rate, reset}; now is the value Time.GetUnixTime() returns (a double), rate the cached quest_mindelta_rate. out: {result, registry}; registry is GetQuests() in HashSet order as [quest_name, last_time_completed, num_times_completed, character_id]. A TimeSpan result is {ticks, total_seconds, friendly (GetFriendlyString)}; a call that throws is {throws: <type>}.
